issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns on missing unzip and bad args but does not exit, letting the script proceed into a broken state
issues.detail: The unzip-missing branch and the argument-count error path both print a message and fall through. The script then attempts unzip anyway or calls realpath on unset $1, producing opaque downstream failures. Add exit 1 after both warnings so misuse and missing prerequisites surface immediately rather than as cryptic later errors.

issues.description: README links to a config path (conf/train/...) that does not exist in the tree
issues.detail: README references ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml but the actual file lives at conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml with no train/ subdir. Readers following the link hit 404 on day one. Fix the link or move the file so documentation matches the tree.

issues.description: Hardcoded utterance counts in data.sh heredoc are brittle and undocumented
issues.detail: Counts 22467, 3208, 6072, 29386, 38924 are checked against wc -l of text with no comment stating they come from a specific TAL split version. Any upstream dataset shift fails the check with no clue why. Add a comment citing the dataset snapshot, or separate the integrity check from the partition definitions so the recipe describes layout, not dataset version.

issues.description: Transcript normalization chain of inline seds hides the actual character map
issues.detail: Multiple chained sed substitutions encode a normalization policy (full-width A to ASCII, strip punctuation) as shell syntax rather than data. Auditing or extending the rule set requires reading the pipeline. Collapse to a single sed -e ... or a small replacement table read via sed -f so the policy is an inspectable value with a stated rationale.

issues.description: data.sh writes utt.list twice with different semantics and joins transcripts via paste without a keyed-join invariant
issues.detail: utt.list is first written from wav.flist then silently overwritten from transcripts.txt after filter_scp.pl. The subsequent paste over sort -u relies on both files having identical utterance sets; any filter asymmetry produces misaligned (uttid, text) pairs with no error. Replace paste with join -1 1 -2 1 or assert count equality, and document which utt.list is authoritative.

issues.description: realpath arguments in download_and_untar.sh are unquoted, breaking on paths with spaces
issues.detail: extract_dir=$(realpath $1) and zip_dir=$(realpath ${2:-$extract_dir}) lack quotes while the rest of the script quotes expansions correctly. Any path containing a space silently corrupts the extraction target. Quote them as $(realpath "$1") and $(realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}").

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a typical egs2 recipe addition where the boilerplate symlinks and YAML are fine, but the two new shell scripts carry the real issues. The unanimous P1 is download_and_untar.sh's warn-and-continue pattern for missing unzip and bad args, which masks precondition failures as cryptic downstream errors. Three reviewers also independently flagged the broken README config link, the undocumented hardcoded utterance counts, and the inline sed normalization chain as cleanup items. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — fix the exit-on-error paths, quote realpath args, address the silent paste-join risk in data.sh, and fix the README link before merge.
